params.message:
Rate-the-seller link for an unknown bidding answers 404 instead of 500

addDealerVote read vehicle_id on a null export vehicle when the id in the
URL matched no bidding. It now aborts with 404, as storeDealerVote already did.

Portal: A rating link that points to a bidding that no longer exists now shows a clear "not found" page instead of an error.
Nightwatch: 82
